tickets.krug_law: First Law: Don't Make Me Think! (Eliminate Raw JSON & Sync 4 Visual Previews)
tickets.module_source: Classify Module (Noise & Clutter) + Generate Module (Billboard Design)
tickets.problem_diagnosis:
In dist/app.js (line 183), Screen M4 renders raw JSON (
JSON.stringify
) instead of visual cards, and src/App.svelte (line 284) dropped the 4 format tabs (Infographic 4:5, Carousel 4-Slide, IG Story 9:16, Reel Beat Sheet). A marketer should never read raw JSON.
tickets.redesign_prescription: Render visual billboard previews for all 4 formats (4:5 Infographic card, 4-slide Carousel deck, 9:16 Story with interactive poll sticker, and 3-beat Reel storyboard table) with inline editing in both src/App.svelte and dist/app.js.

tickets.krug_law: Affordance & Convention Law (Fix Fake 'Ask Studio Agent' Input Box)
tickets.problem_diagnosis: The bottom of the right-hand Liquidity Studio Agent sidebar renders 'Ask Studio Agent...' inside a static <div> styled like an input field. Clicking it does nothing, immediately draining Krug's Goodwill Reservoir.
tickets.redesign_prescription: Convert 'Ask Studio Agent...' into a real, working <input> + submit form that lets the marketer type natural-language quick commands (e.g., 'Make headline punchier', 'Schedule for Friday', or 'Add story') and executes them immediately.

tickets.krug_law: Trunk Test Question #1 & #2 (Fix Site ID '←' Back-Arrow & Strip Internal M1/A4 Spec Codes)
tickets.module_source: Retrieve Module (Navigation & Information Scent) + Trunk Test Evaluator
tickets.problem_diagnosis: 1) Top-left Site ID says '← Liquidity Studio v0', making it look like a Back button rather than a home brand identity. 2) Primary tabs say 'M1. Brand Overview', 'M2. Weekly Backlog', 'A4. Context Graph', leaking internal engineering spec IDs into the user UI.
tickets.redesign_prescription: Replace '← Liquidity Studio v0' with a clickable top-left brand mark ('💎 The Liquidity Desk') that resets to Home, and rename tabs to high-scent labels: 'Brand Kit', 'Backlog', 'Calendar', and 'Campaign Studio' with a clear step progress indicator.

tickets.krug_law: Trunk Test Question #6 (Add Instant Search & Status/Pillar Filter to Backlog & Calendar)
tickets.problem_diagnosis: Trunk Test fails question #6 ('How can I search?'). When weekly batch jobs populate dozens of stories, search-dominant users have no way to filter the Backlog or Calendar by keyword, category, or status ('Draft Ready', 'Scheduled', 'Exported').
tickets.redesign_prescription: Add a persistent Search & Status Filter bar ('🔍 Search stories or metrics...' + status filter pills: All | Draft Ready | Scheduled | Exported) at the top of the Backlog and Calendar views.

tickets.krug_law: Satisficing & Mindless Clicks (1-Click 'Schedule & Export' Flow Inside Screen M4)
tickets.problem_diagnosis: To format a story AND approve its calendar day, the user currently has to bounce between Backlog -> Multi-Format Exporter -> Calendar -> Approve (4 clicks across 3 tabs). Furthermore, Calendar slices(0,5), hiding Saturday and Sunday stories.
tickets.redesign_prescription: 1) Add an inline Day Selector + '📅 Schedule & Export' action directly inside the Multi-Format Exporter header so the marketer can format, schedule, and export in one place. 2) Render all 7 days (Mon–Sun) on the Content Calendar with a direct 'Open Studio →' button on every slot.

tickets.krug_law: Affordance Integrity on Brand Kit (Interactive Logo URL & Editable Hex Swatches)
tickets.module_source: Classify Module (Eliminate Dead Affordances on Screen M1)
tickets.problem_diagnosis: On Screen M1 (Brand Overview), the '+ Add a logo' card and the 4 circular color swatches look interactive but are static dead clicks.
tickets.redesign_prescription: Make the Brand Kit color swatches editable via native <input type='color'> pickers and make '+ Add a logo' toggle a clean logo text/monogram badge that immediately updates the live 4:5 Infographic and 9:16 Story previews.

tickets.krug_law: Third Law: Omit Needless Words (Cut Instructional & Co-Pilot Happy Talk by 50%)
tickets.problem_diagnosis: Hero subheader (16 words) and Studio Agent intro ('Hi 👋 I'm your Pomelli-style campaign co-pilot. Pick an action below:' — 12 words) repeat what the buttons already say.
tickets.redesign_prescription: Trim hero subheader to 7 words ('Turn weekly liquidity trends into 4-channel campaigns.') and replace agent happy talk with a live contextual status cue ('Active: Angel City FC • 4 formats ready').
